authority.stata_runtime_target: Stata 17 executing do-file under version 16.0 compatibility semantics

coefficient.rule: PASS if absolute difference <= 1e-8 OR relative difference <= 1e-8 for every common slope coefficient

standard_error.raw_strict_rule: PASS_RAW if relative difference <= 0.001 for every common slope coefficient
standard_error.diagnostic_rule: If any raw relative difference exceeds 0.001, HOLD and diagnose only documented covariance finite-sample/degree-of-freedom implementation differences. No data, variable, model, sample, or significance-driven change is allowed.
standard_error.reconciled_rule: A reconciled pass is permitted only if the discrepancy is reproduced by an explicit deterministic scaling or covariance convention difference and the reconciled relative difference is <= 1e-8.

inference.direction: must match for every common slope coefficient
inference.alpha_005_classification: must match unless a difference is mechanically attributable to a prospectively documented covariance finite-sample convention and is reported transparently
inference.confidence_interval: compare after any permitted covariance reconciliation

anti_post_hoc: Python output must be frozen before Stata 17 verification
Do not change sample based on signs or p-values
Do not change indicators based on signs or p-values
Do not change model based on signs or p-values
Do not select the more favorable engine
Any discrepancy triggers diagnosis, not model redesign
